integration_rule: Re-read origin/main and the hosted ledger immediately before integration.

Hard ordering constraint (reproduced on PostgreSQL 17): Finance 337_audit_export_scope_and_snapshot.sql alters audit_log_export_jobs.row_count to bigint, and PostgreSQL refuses ALTER TYPE on a column referenced by a policy. COL-133's operation_export_job_current and operation_export_job_insert_current reference row_count, so Finance's file must apply first. If COL-133 must land first, drop and recreate those two policies around Finance's ALTER in the integration commit.

Renumber 336_hfo_activity_catalog.sql and 337_hfo_current_authority.sql to the first two free numbers after whatever has merged by then, keeping their suffixes and relative order; update docs/specs/README.md and the two handoffs to the final numbers in the same commit.

Apply the reconcile migration (proposed_audit_export_current_authority_reconcile.sql) as the first migration after both Finance 337 and COL-133 authority have landed, together with its probe; carry the Finance probe fixture adaptation and retire the COL-133 Edge harness test in the same integration commit.
Schema/RPC installation precedes the matching API/Edge release; the four changed Edge functions and the operations API routes must not be released ahead of the migration.
Never rewrite installed ledger history or drop classification/audit data; forward repair only.

Do not deploy this migration alone to an operating facility. Legacy classification, required scoped commands and affected consumers (see COL-133-HANDOFF.md, Material compatibility boundaries) are reconciled in a coordinated release.

semantic_differences_resolved: Finance let owner/org_admin export any site by role via haven.has_facility_access; COL-133 requires an explicit unexpired current site grant for corporate roles too. Both are enforced: haven.can_export_audit_scope_current = F01 scope AND haven.operation_facility_access.

Finance materialized audit_log as SECURITY DEFINER, bypassing the COL-133 RESTRICTIVE audit_log policies; the reconcile applies the identical predicate (haven.operation_audit_row_current) and the probe proves snapshot ids equal the RLS-visible ids for a site admin and for an owner.
COL-133 hides completed export jobs from the requester; Finance's retrieve reads the job as definer, so retrieval still works, and its forge-completion assertion was moved to a visible pending job.
COL-133's Edge-side completion RPC is superseded by the snapshot path and revoked from authenticated so a job cannot be marked completed without evidence.

open_decisions: Completed export jobs: COL-133 hides them from the requester's list (status/row_count restrictive policy) while Finance's UI expects to list snapshot-bearing completed jobs for download. Retrieval stays authority-checked in the database, so allowing the list to show completed jobs that carry a snapshot would lose no protection. Integrator's decision; not made here.
